note: endpoint -> the Houdini nodetype(s) that handler creates. Hand-verified against houdini_executor/handlers/*.py (decorator-anchored). Powers the :tool=/:UNEXPOSED coverage flags in NODE_REFERENCE.md via scripts/generate_docs.py --coverage. Plumbing nodetypes (geo/object_merge/xform/python/file) are included where created; the join only annotates nodetypes that actually appear in the reference. Keep in sync when handlers change (the generator warns on catalog tools missing here). Bulk entries are auto-derived by scripts/derive_tool_nodes.py (first node-creating call per endpoint); re-run it with --write after adding handlers -- it preserves hand-maintained entries and only adds missing tools. Optional "category" (e.g. "Cop") disambiguates same-named nodes across categories in the coverage join; entries without it are category-agnostic (legacy).
